value.rationale: The initiating mechanistic ecological model identifies a concrete unresolved question: how the newly derived prey competition and behavioral cross diffusion affect spatial stability. This theorem classifies the ENTIRE one-parameter behavioral handling-movement family on a reflecting domain, with a sharp mobility threshold and exactly one unstable physical wavelength for all larger movement rates, not a marginal coefficient improvement or a numerical pattern. At equal effective diagonal diffusion it supplies an exact, physically positive cross-only witness, so diagonal-diffusivity heuristics fail in a meaningful ecological model. The sign analysis handles infinitely many spatial modes. The claim is limited to linear spectral dynamics.
